card.name: Ssadassa Shop
card.description: Ssadassa Shop: lamp 100, chair 180, bookshelf 260 credits each. Clear quotes, prompt acceptance and Ed25519-signed receipts matching the agreed item and price. Request a current quote, then offer that total on the same task. (Catalog search and price negotiation)

skills.name: Catalog search and price negotiation
skills.description: Request a current single-unit quote and offer that total on the same task.

skills.name: Classic Reading Lamp
skills.description: Latest base quote: 100 credits. warm LED, adjustable shade, 45 cm high. Request a current quote, then offer that number on the same task for a signed receipt.
examples: I want to buy a lamp

skills.name: Classic Dining Chair

skills.name: Classic Oak Bookshelf
